description.p: Punktfunk plays games and uses the desktop of a computer running the Punktfunk host, with low latency over your network. The stream arrives at this screen's resolution and refresh rate, without scaling.

Mit Punktfunk spielst du über dein Netzwerk mit geringer Latenz die Spiele eines Computers, auf dem der Punktfunk-Host läuft, und nutzt seinen Desktop. Der Stream kommt in der Auflösung und Bildwiederholrate dieses Bildschirms an, ohne Skalierung.

Con Punktfunk juegas y usas el escritorio de un equipo que ejecuta el host de Punktfunk, con baja latencia a través de tu red. La transmisión llega a la resolución y la frecuencia de actualización de esta pantalla, sin escalado.

Punktfunk vous fait jouer et utiliser le bureau d’un ordinateur qui exécute l’hôte Punktfunk, avec une faible latence sur votre réseau. Le flux arrive à la résolution et à la fréquence de rafraîchissement de cet écran, sans mise à l’échelle.

Punktfunk ti permette di giocare e usare il desktop di un computer su cui è in esecuzione l’host Punktfunk, con bassa latenza sulla tua rete. Lo streaming arriva alla risoluzione e alla frequenza di aggiornamento di questo schermo, senza ridimensionamento.

O Punktfunk permite jogar e usar a área de trabalho de um computador que executa o host do Punktfunk, com baixa latência pela sua rede. A transmissão chega na resolução e na taxa de atualização desta tela, sem redimensionamento.
You need the Punktfunk host on the computer you stream from. It runs on Linux and Windows.
Auf dem Computer, von dem du streamst, brauchst du den Punktfunk-Host. Er läuft unter Linux und Windows.
Necesitas el host de Punktfunk en el equipo desde el que transmites. Funciona en Linux y Windows.
Il vous faut l’hôte Punktfunk sur l’ordinateur depuis lequel vous diffusez. Il fonctionne sous Linux et Windows.
Ti serve l’host Punktfunk sul computer da cui trasmetti. Funziona su Linux e Windows.
Você precisa do host do Punktfunk no computador de onde transmite. Ele funciona no Linux e no Windows.

description.p: Right colours on Snapdragon devices and AMD RX 9000 hosts, Umbriel as a host desktop, a steadier automatic bitrate, Bazzite hosts that survive a reboot, and Switch 2 pads.
Stream to every monitor, keep the stream through a dropped link, share the clipboard with the host, and get even frame pacing on the Steam Deck.
Players on a Linux host keep their controllers apart, hosts reachable without logging in serve their library, and video gets priority on Wi-Fi again.
Profiles let everyone on the host pick who is playing, every stream uses one port, and lost packets are sent again instead of freezing the picture. Needs a 0.44 host.
gamescope sessions on NVIDIA and Intel show a picture again, Windows hosts keep every frame of a capped game, and the network check reports fast links at their speed.
Hosts install games when you start them, a network check says what your link does and offers paced delivery, and controller rumble can be turned off.
The Linux client is redesigned with Hosts and Library tabs and decodes in hardware on ARM devices, controller mouse gains a Touchpad mode, and 4K streams at 120 fps and above keep up again.
A game you launched can be ended from any client, keys no longer stick when a packet is lost, and large libraries load a page at a time.
The console is rebuilt for the TV remote, with Hosts, Games, Controllers and Settings tabs and a Games tab laid out like the Mac library.
Two players can share one host, a launch waits for the game's window, and automatic bitrate measures the link before the first frame.
